title: 5.3 Substance Abuse
description: Drug classification, substance abuse, alcohol, tobacco, khat, and addiction

questions.question: What is a drug?
options: Only illegal substances that cause hallucinations
Any substance taken into the body that changes or affects chemical reactions in the body
questions.answer: Any substance taken into the body that changes or affects chemical reactions in the body

questions.question: What is substance abuse?
options: Taking medicine as prescribed by a doctor
Using legal or illegal drugs in the wrong way or in excessive amounts
questions.answer: Using legal or illegal drugs in the wrong way or in excessive amounts

questions.question: Which of the following is classified as a stimulant?

What is tar?
options: A black sticky substance found in cigarette smoke that collects in the lungs and can cause chronic bronchitis and lung cancer

questions.answer: A black sticky substance found in cigarette smoke that collects in the lungs and can cause chronic bronchitis and lung cancer

questions.question: What disease is caused by the accumulation of tar in the bronchioles, leading to excess mucus and breathing difficulty?

options: It stimulates the production of red blood cells
It binds permanently with hemoglobin, reducing the amount of oxygen carried in the blood
questions.answer: It binds permanently with hemoglobin, reducing the amount of oxygen carried in the blood

questions.question: What is the role of nicotine in cigarette smoking?
options: It is a stimulant that produces addiction
questions.answer: It is a stimulant that produces addiction

options: It slows down the transmission of nerve impulses
It has no effect on the nervous system
